profile_text.body:
Hut 8 Corp. is a public company headquartered in Miami, Florida, and trades under the ticker HUT. According to its website, it owns, operates and scales purpose-built businesses that acquire, deploy and monetize specialized hardware for next-generation, energy-intensive technologies. The company describes this portfolio as providing direct exposure to markets created by transformative technologies such as AI and Bitcoin mining.

The site also states that Hut 8 has fully commercialized a 1 GW Beacon Point AI data center campus with a second 352 MW IT lease, which it says brings campus-level base-term contract value to $19.6 billion.

Company records list a CIK of 0001964789. Its recorded litigation exposure is in Florida, with 96 matters.
